title: Madrid Residency Night 3 — Young Miko Ignites La Casita; 192,000+ Fans Through Three Sold-Out Shows
detail: Bad Bunny performed Night 3 of his 10-night residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid on June 2, 2026, before a sold-out crowd of approximately 64,000 — opening the second back-to-back cluster (June 2–3) of the historic engagement. Through three nights, the residency has drawn 192,000+ fans, on pace toward the projected 640,000 total across all 10 shows (May 30–31 and June 2, 3, 6, 7, 10, 11, 14, 15), the largest single-artist concert run in Spanish history. The night's landmark surprise was the appearance of Puerto Rican LGBTQ+ rapper Young Miko, who climbed atop La Casita — the secondary elevated platform at center stage — to perform the pair's 2023 collaboration 'FINA,' sending the 64,000-strong crowd into a frenzy. Young Miko then delivered three additional solo tracks: 'Chulo Pt. 2,' 'WASSUP,' and her then-new single 'BIAF<3.' The Night 3 appearance continued the residency's pattern of nightly surprise guests — Night 1 (May 30) brought the first-ever live collaboration between Bad Bunny and Myke Towers; Night 2 (May 31) featured Dominican-American rapper Luar La L performing 'Teléfono Nuevo.' Each night's unique guest moment is becoming a defining element of the Madrid engagement. The DtMF World Tour production opened with 'La Mudanza' as usual, running through the full album arc, YHLQMDLG, and El Último Tour del Mundo, with the life-size sapo concho and replica Humacao house central to the Puerto Rican stage design. After Madrid, the European leg continues in Düsseldorf (June 20–21), Arnhem (June 23–24), London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium (June 27–28), and closes in Brussels on July 22, 2026.
